text:
elsa: New hire hit a weird auth failure during onboarding near the end of the lab when we rotated keys. They swapped REDWOOD_API_KEY and sampleapp immediately returned 401.
noah: Any logs?
elsa: App stdout: "401 Unauthorized: invalid key scope". No other helpful header. They were using our docker onboarding image.
priya: Do we know which env vars they had?
elsa: Container had REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME baked into image .env; CI injected REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_PROJECT at runtime. But app prioritized the baked .env and ended up using the wrong project var.
dylan: Classic. Also noticed parity issue: CLI accepts --project, Python/Go prefer REDWOOD_PROJECT, Node still reads REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME.
noah: Outcome: rotated key is project-scoped but runtime app doesn't advertise project (uses wrong var) -> server rejects.
priya: Two short-term mitigations: 1) sampleapp should prefer process env over .env and have STARTUP_USE_DOTENV=false by default. 2) SDKs should accept both REDWOOD_PROJECT and REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME (preferring REDWOOD_PROJECT) and log which was used.
elsa: Also the retry behavior masks the problem: SDKs currently retry on 401 forever in some languages. We should treat 401/403 as non-retry unless server sets Retry-After or x-redwood-retryable-auth.
dylan: For debugging, backend adding `x-redwood-expected-scope: project` and `x-redwood-provided-scope` would cut troubleshooting time in half. I'll file backend ticket.
priya: Quick UX: add a startup smoke check in sampleapp: if REDWOOD_API_KEY present and no detectable project env -> exit 1 with "AuthError: missing project scope. set REDWOOD_PROJECT or REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME" and link to onboarding doc.
noah: I'd also like a one-off gate in CI that runs `redwood doctor` (tiny tool) before running labs to catch these env mismatches.
ci-bot: CI: onboarding-gate #77 queued
dylan: I'll PR Node SDK parity and a test for env precedence. Please include a CHANGES note about deprecating REDWOOD_PROJECT_NAME and print a one-time deprecation warning when only the old var is present.
elsa: Docs: I'll update the sampleapp README and onboarding checklist. Targeting docs patch today and SDK patch release this week.
priya: Assignments: dylan SDK PR, elsa sampleapp/docs + startup check, noah add CI gate, dylan file backend header ticket.
noah: Thanks. We'll follow up with PR links and CI run results.
